_readme: Owner decisions for the identity resolver (packages/ingest/src/identity). 'same': these member records are one person (optional personId pins the ID the group keeps). 'different': these two records are different people. Official evidence (CDEP career links, simultaneous seats) is applied automatically and does not need an entry here. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-014.

same.reason: Former president Ion Iliescu: Bucharest senator 1996-2000 and 2004-2008. The Hunedoara deputy (1990) / senator (2000) of the same name is a different person (CDEP links his two mandates to each other, not to these).

Review row 3, web research 2026-10-04. Ioan Moldovan: Wikidata holds two items for the 1990-1992 and 2012-2016 (Cluj) deputy with the identical birth date, 26 January 1951 (Q12730678, Q21747025): one man entered twice.

Review row 6, web research 2026-10-04. Ioan Ardelean: one Wikidata item (Q12730593, born 14 January 1945) carries both the deputy and senator positions, and CDEP's 1990 Salaj deputy page gives the same birth date.

Review row 7, web research 2026-10-04. Dumitru Badea: one ro.wikipedia article (born 12 August 1939, PRM) lists deputy for Dambovita in 1992 (a May-October 1992 replacement) and senator for Neamt 1996-2004; Wikidata Q18537646 likewise.

different.reason: Ion Iliescu the former president was President of Romania in 1990 and from December 2000 to December 2004, so he cannot be the Hunedoara deputy of 1990 or the Hunedoara senator of 2000-2004. CDEP links those two mandates to each other and the president's Bucharest Senate mandates (1996, 2004) to each other, never across.
Gheorghe Roman: official CDEP CVs show different birth dates 1949-03-27 vs 1972-02-06. Review row 9, 2026-10-03.
Valentin. Vasilescu: official CDEP CVs show different birth dates 1935-11-06 vs 1961-06-16. Review row 13, 2026-10-03.

Review row 4, web research 2026-10-04. Virgil Popescu: ro.wikipedia 'Virgil Popescu (senator)' (born 20 June 1947) lists the 1996-2000 Dolj Senate seat and the 2000-2004 deputy seat as his earliest mandates; no 1990 Mehedinti deputy mandate, so that deputy is another man.

Review row 5, web research 2026-10-04. Ion Stefan: Wikidata Q28193538 (born 22 January 1969, Vrancea deputy 2016-2024) was 21 in 1990, below the minimum age of a deputy, and the Braila deputy of 1990/2000 is another man.

Review row 9, web research 2026-10-04. Ion Neagu: ro.wikipedia 'Ion Neagu (senator)' (born 20 December 1951: senator 1990-1992, deputy 1992-1996 Calarasi) and a separate article 'Ion Neagu (politician)' for the Bucharest deputy of 2000.
